Draven.escape: Draven has no skill to create distance on his own, so engage when Draven E Stand Aside is down and he has one axe or fewer. Close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble, but check your escape route first. If you don’t have an angle to pin him against a wall, use Vayne E Condemn to make him miss an axe or to peel an enemy who has reached you.
Draven.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive early. Draven deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first and buy Plated Steelcaps. Keep your total health in mind because of the execute threshold on Draven R Whirling Death.
Draven.combo: When there’s a wall behind Draven, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up Vayne E Condemn and knock him into the wall for a stun. For a short trade, build stacks with basic attacks and finish with Vayne Q Tumble’s empowered attack.
Draven.fight: Don’t fight Draven while he has two axes; look for an opening when he has one or none. Use Vayne E Condemn to knock him away from where he’s moving to catch an axe, making him miss it. Start trading when he steps forward to last-hit, attack only long enough to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts on the same target, then back away.
Draven.laning: Vayne is weak early, so don’t force the wave forward; farm safely near your turret. If trading is difficult, focus on not giving Draven a kill. Wait for Draven to step forward and for your jungler to have room to come in.
Draven.phase: In the mid game, look for Draven when he’s alone, together with your allies. Vayne gets stronger in the mid to late game as her skills and items come online, so keep limiting early losses.
Draven.teamfight: Join after your team starts the fight and the enemy’s engage tools and targeted crowd control have been used. Near a wall, use Vayne E Condemn to stun Draven or make him miss an axe. Once you choose a target, stick to it and build Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on that champion.
Draven.watch: Draven’s basic attacks hit hard early while he holds two Draven Q Spinning Axes, so avoid trading. Watch for the slow and displacement from Draven E Stand Aside. After dodging Draven R Whirling Death once, get out of its return path too. If your health is low, beware of the execute from Draven R Whirling Death.

Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong early, so Vayne should farm near your turret, avoid giving up kills, and buy time. Caitlyn’s relative strength falls as the game goes on, while Vayne is strong in the mid to late game with attack speed and penetration items. Focus on limiting early losses until you complete three core items.
Caitlyn.build: Start with Cloth Armor and buy Plated Steelcaps. Caitlyn’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items to counter the root from Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap.
Caitlyn.combo: Then knock Caitlyn into the wall with Vayne E Condemn to stun her, and use the time to keep basic attacking the same target and proc Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Caitlyn.escape: You can close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble when you see Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker’s cast animation or just after she uses it to clear the wave.
Caitlyn.fight: Start trading when Caitlyn steps forward to last-hit or just after she uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to clear the wave. Keep attacking the same target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble.
Caitlyn.laning: In the early game, don’t force the wave forward; keep it near your turret and farm. Caitlyn’s long range makes it easy to lose health, so avoid short trades that can’t proc Vayne W Silver Bolts. Save Vayne E Condemn unless you can use it on Caitlyn with a wall behind her.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Go in after your team starts the fight and the enemy’s engage tools and targeted crowd control have been used. Near a wall, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up a stun with Vayne E Condemn. Once you’re on a target, avoid switching often and build Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one champion.
Caitlyn.watch: If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you’ll be rooted and hit by Caitlyn P Headshot’s long-range empowered attack. Watch for traps in bushes and narrow paths, and change your approach route.

Ezreal.build: The information provided isn’t enough to determine a starting item. If you build resistance, consider both the physical damage from Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and the magic damage from Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift. Movement speed to close the gap and effects that reduce the enemy’s attack speed are also useful.
Ezreal.combo: When Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down and there’s a wall behind him, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up your approach. Then knock him into the wall with Vayne E Condemn for a stun and focus your attacks to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts. If there’s no wall, save Vayne E Condemn because it can push Ezreal out of your range.
Ezreal.escape: The opening to engage is right after you make Ezreal use his escape, Ezreal E Arcane Shift. Close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble, but check your exit route before going in.
Ezreal.fight: Take a short trade when Ezreal steps forward to last-hit, proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble. After baiting out Ezreal E Arcane Shift, go in again for a chance to catch him. If Ezreal keeps hitting Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, his escape comes back sooner, so keep minions between you during the engage.
Ezreal.laning: In the early game, don’t force the wave forward; keep it near your turret and farm. Move within the minion wave to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, and don’t trade long-range poke where there are no minions.
Ezreal.phase: In the mid game, investing in Vayne Q Tumble lets you look for trades more often. Vayne gets stronger in the late game as she builds attack speed and penetration items, so avoid forced early fights and buy time to scale.
Ezreal.teamfight: Don’t start the team fight; go in after your team engages and the enemy’s engage tools and targeted crowd control have been used. Don’t trade poke with Ezreal from far away; use vision and your angle to close the gap. Look for a stun with Vayne E Condemn near a wall, then focus attacks on one target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Ezreal.watch: Dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot from behind minions. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, his next basic attack or ability deals extra damage, so briefly move out of range. When your health is low, retreat along terrain to avoid the straight path of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.

Aphelios.fight: When Aphelios has a weapon with low burst damage, trade only when he steps forward to last-hit. Stack basic attacks on one target, then finish with Vayne Q Tumble’s empowered attack to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts and back away. Don’t trade if you can’t proc Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Aphelios.teamfight: Go in after your team starts the fight and Aphelios’s root and the enemy’s engage tools have been used. Spread out before engaging so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn’t hit multiple allies. Near a wall, look for a stun with Vayne E Condemn. Once you’re on a target, don’t switch; build Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one champion.
Aphelios.laning: Vayne has low health and armor and short range early, so don’t force the wave forward. Farm near your turret instead. Don’t keep giving up health to Aphelios’s Calibrum marks. If Gravitum slows you, immediately create distance to dodge the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Save Vayne E Condemn for targets with a wall behind them rather than using it to poke Aphelios.
Aphelios.build: Start with Cloth Armor and buy Plated Steelcaps. Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, and Vayne has low armor, so build armor first. If you often get caught by Gravitum’s root, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items. If healing makes fights last longer, consider Executioner's Calling after one core item.
Aphelios.combo: To catch Aphelios with a wall behind him, use Vayne Q Tumble to position so the wall is behind him. Then knock him into it with Vayne E Condemn to stun him, and use the time to basic attack the same target and proc Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Aphelios.escape: Don’t rush in while Aphelios can use Gravitum’s slow and the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Once that crowd control is down and he isn’t holding Severum, close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble. Unlike when chasing, Vayne doesn’t gain bonus movement speed from her passive while retreating, so check your escape route before going in.
Aphelios.phase: In the mid game, check Aphelios’s weapons and trade only when his burst damage is low. Vayne gets stronger as she invests in Q and completes core items, so avoid falling behind early and buy time to scale.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios’s Gravitum basic attack slows you, move out of range before Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites roots you. If marked by Calibrum, you can be hit from beyond his usual range, so back away to preserve your health. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil triggers an extra attack from his main weapon for each champion hit, so spread out from your allies when he can use it.

Seraphine.combo: After Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up a wall behind her. Then push Seraphine into the wall with Vayne E Condemn to stun her, and use that time to attack the same target and proc Vayne W Silver Bolts. If there is no wall, save Vayne E Condemn because it can push Seraphine out of range.
Seraphine.build: While building core items, fit Quicksilver Sash into Vayne's build if immobilizing crowd control such as Seraphine E Beat Drop's root is a threat. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Seraphine's main damage. If healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound is enough to offset Vayne W Silver Bolts' damage, buy Executioner's Calling after one core item.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility, so the moment after you dodge Seraphine E Beat Drop is an opportunity to go in with Vayne Q Tumble. You may need Vayne E Condemn for defense, so check your retreat path before engaging. If Seraphine R Encore is available, watch for its charm as you choose your engage position.
Seraphine.fight: Start a trade when Seraphine steps forward to last-hit or is alone and separated from her allies. Make a basic attack, then change position with Vayne Q Tumble while stacking Vayne W Silver Bolts on the same target. If Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble, but check your retreat path first.
Seraphine.laning: Vayne has low health and armor early and short basic attack range, so don't force the lane forward. Keep the wave near your allied turret and farm; trade briefly only when Seraphine steps forward alone. Don't start a trade if you can't proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, and don't use Vayne E Condemn carelessly.
Seraphine.phase: Continuing to put skill points into Vayne Q Tumble makes trades faster, and Vayne grows strong in mid to late game when she has attack speed and penetration items. Play to buy time until you complete three core items.
Seraphine.teamfight: Don't start team fights as Vayne; wait for your allies to engage and for the enemy's engage tools and crowd control to be used. Spread out to the left and right to keep Seraphine R Encore from extending through allies. If you close in on Seraphine near a wall, pin her against it with Vayne E Condemn, then focus your attacks on one target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. In team fights, the charm from Seraphine R Encore reaches farther by passing through allies, so spread out to either side.

Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you’re hit by three or more returning feathers. If three or more feathers lie along a line connecting you and Xayah, sidestep with Vayne Q Tumble.
Xayah.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Xayah deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. If the root from Xayah E Bladecaller is a concern, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items.
Xayah.combo: When Xayah R Featherstorm is down and there’s a wall behind her, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up Vayne E Condemn and stun her against the wall.
Xayah.escape: Engage after getting out of the return path of Xayah E Bladecaller, and check your retreat route first.
Xayah.fight: Trade briefly only when Xayah steps forward to last-hit. Don’t stay in one spot for long; trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts on one target, then use Vayne Q Tumble to leave the feathers’ return path.
Xayah.laning: Watch for the area damage from Xayah P Clean Cuts and Xayah Q Double Daggers. End the trade and reposition before feathers build up.
Xayah.phase: In the mid game, investing more points in Vayne Q Tumble makes trades faster, and Vayne gets stronger in the mid to late game as she builds attack speed and penetration items.
Xayah.teamfight: Don’t start fights. Engage after Xayah R Featherstorm and the enemy’s engage abilities and crowd control are down. Near a wall, look for a stun with Vayne E Condemn, and focus your attacks on one target to trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts.

Ashe.build: Start with Cloth Armor and buy Plated Steelcaps. Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Vayne has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Ashe.combo: Use Vayne Q Tumble to position with a wall behind Ashe, then knock her into it with Vayne E Condemn. Away from a wall, Vayne E Condemn can push Ashe out of your range, so save it.
Ashe.escape: Engage after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended. Don’t start a skirmish from outside vision while Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available. Check your escape route before going in, then close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble.
Ashe.fight: Start trading when Ashe W Volley is down and she steps forward to last-hit. Attack the same target enough to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble. If Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, wait for it to end.
Ashe.laning: Vayne has short range and is weak early, so don’t force the wave forward. Farm near your turret instead. Dodge Ashe W Volley by moving sideways, and take short trades only while it’s down to limit your losses.
Ashe.phase: In the mid game, investing in Vayne Q Tumble lets you trade more quickly. Vayne gets stronger in the late game as she builds attack speed and penetration items, so avoid losing early and buy time to scale.
Ashe.teamfight: Go in after your team starts the fight and the enemy’s engage tools and crowd control have been used. If you reach Ashe near a wall, use Vayne E Condemn to knock her into it and look for a stun. Then keep attacking one target to build Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks instead of switching targets.
Ashe.watch: Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow refreshes with every basic attack, so don’t stay within her attack range for long. Dodge Ashe W Volley by moving sideways, and create distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow travels in a straight line, so don’t run straight away from it.

Jhin.build: Start with Cloth Armor and buy Plated Steelcaps. Jhin deals mostly physical damage, and Vayne has low armor, so build armor first. If you often get caught by Jhin W Deadly Flourish, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
Jhin.combo: Use Vayne Q Tumble to position with a wall behind Jhin, then knock him into it with Vayne E Condemn to stun him. Away from a wall, save Vayne E Condemn because it can push Jhin out of your range.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no skill to create distance on his own, so dodge Jhin W Deadly Flourish and close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble while he’s reloading. If rooted, you can’t use Vayne Q Tumble, so immediately after taking a basic attack from Jhin or stepping on a trap, first move out of the line of Jhin W Deadly Flourish.
Jhin.fight: Take a short trade when Jhin steps forward to last-hit while reloading or after firing one or two shots. Focus attacks on the same target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble. After dodging Jhin W Deadly Flourish, close the gap, but check your escape route first.
Jhin.laning: Vayne has low health and armor and short basic attack range early, so don’t force the wave forward; keep it near your turret and farm. Stand a step away from low-health minions to avoid Jhin Q Dancing Grenade gaining damage when it kills and bounces from a target. If you step on a Jhin E Captive Audience trap, move out before it explodes and avoid Jhin W Deadly Flourish from that position.
Jhin.phase: In the mid game, keep investing in Vayne Q Tumble to create more trading opportunities, but back away while Jhin has his final shot loaded. Vayne gets strong in the mid to late game as she builds attack speed and penetration items, so survive the early game and scale.
Jhin.teamfight: Go in after your team starts the fight and the enemy’s crowd control, including Jhin W Deadly Flourish, has been used. Near a wall, look for an angle to stun Jhin with Vayne E Condemn. Once you’re on a target, don’t switch; build Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one champion.
Jhin.watch: Beware of Jhin’s high damage while his final shot is loaded, and look for an opening to engage while he’s reloading. When your health is low, dodge the Jhin R Curtain Call shots, which deal more damage based on missing health. Stand away from low-health minions to avoid Jhin Q Dancing Grenade.

Jinx.build: Start with Cloth Armor and buy Plated Steelcaps. Jinx deals mostly physical damage, and Vayne has low armor, so build armor first. If the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers! is a threat, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
Jinx.combo: Use Vayne Q Tumble to position with a wall behind Jinx, then knock her into it with Vayne E Condemn to stun her.
Jinx.escape: Jinx has no skill to create distance on her own, so engage after she uses or misses Jinx E Flame Chompers! If Jinx W Zap! also misses, close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble, but check your escape route first. Don’t start a fight right after Jinx P Get Excited! triggers because an ally dies or a turret falls.
Jinx.fight: Look to trade when Jinx pokes with Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets or steps forward to last-hit. If Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down and Jinx W Zap! misses, close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble. Keep attacking the same target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble.
Jinx.laning: When Jinx farms with rockets, stand away from minions so you don’t also take splash damage. Don’t start a short trade if you can’t proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, and save Vayne E Condemn unless Jinx has a wall behind her.
Jinx.phase: Vayne is weak early, so limit CS losses and buy time. Investing in Vayne Q Tumble makes trades faster, and Vayne gets strong in the mid to late game as she builds attack speed and penetration items. Even then, avoid fighting right after Jinx P Get Excited! triggers.
Jinx.teamfight: Join after your team starts the fight and the enemy’s engage tools and crowd control have been used. Engage if Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down or Jinx W Zap! misses, and look for a stun with Vayne E Condemn near a wall. Once you’re on a target, avoid switching often and focus Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one champion.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo!’s rockets also damage nearby targets, so don’t stand right next to minions. Dodge the slow from Jinx W Zap! and the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers! before engaging. If health has been reduced, beware of the finishing damage from Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! and stay out of its range.

Kaisa.build: Start with Cloth Armor and buy Plated Steelcaps. Build armor first to counter the physical damage from Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks.
Kaisa.combo: Use Vayne Q Tumble to position with a wall behind Kai'Sa, then knock her into it with Vayne E Condemn to stun her. If Vayne W Silver Bolts is about to proc, you can make the final attack with Vayne Q Tumble’s empowered basic attack.
Kaisa.escape: Engage with Vayne Q Tumble before Kai'Sa learns Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct or after she uses it. Don’t force a chase while Kai'Sa E Supercharge makes her invisible and increases her movement speed. Before going in, check whether Vayne Q Tumble can also be used to disengage.
Kaisa.fight: When Kai'Sa steps forward to last-hit, attack the same target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble. Check your escape route before engaging, and look for a stun with Vayne E Condemn only when Kai'Sa has a wall behind her.
Kaisa.laning: Take a short trade only when Kai'Sa steps forward to last-hit and you can proc Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Kaisa.phase: Vayne is especially weak early, so limit losses and buy time. In the mid game, watch for Kai'Sa’s item-powered engage, and invest in Vayne Q Tumble to create more trading opportunities. Vayne gets stronger in the late game as she builds attack speed and penetration items, so focus Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one target.
Kaisa.teamfight: If Kai'Sa dives in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, knock her back with Vayne E Condemn, and stun her if you can pin her against a wall. Once you close in, avoid switching targets often and build Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one champion.
Kaisa.watch: Immediately after being hit by Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, watch for her engage with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. Retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. When taking damage from Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, stand near allied minions to spread the missiles. If stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin have built up, wait out of range for them to wear off.

Kalista.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to withstand Kalista's physical damage in the early game. Choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots and prioritize armor. Armor does not mitigate Kalista W Sentinel's damage, so don't rely on simply stacking a lot of health.
Kalista.combo: Use Vayne Q Tumble to line up a wall behind Kalista, then push her into it with Vayne E Condemn to stun her. During a trade, use basic attacks followed by Vayne Q Tumble’s empowered basic attack to apply the final stack, but first consider whether you need Q Tumble to disengage.
Kalista.escape: However, Kalista P Martial Poise's leap is still available, so prioritize lining up a Vayne E Condemn stun when there is a wall behind Kalista. Before going in, account for the fact that Vayne P Night Hunter's movement speed bonus doesn't apply while fleeing, and check your retreat path.
Kalista.fight: When Kalista steps forward to last-hit, attack the same target for a short trade to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts. Don't start a trade if you can't proc it, and use Vayne Q Tumble to retreat afterward. If you can push Kalista out of her basic attack range, Vayne E Condemn can interrupt Kalista P Martial Poise's leap, but in areas without a wall, it can also cut your attack opportunity short.
Kalista.laning: When Kalista's basic attack is flying toward you, break vision by moving into brush or behind a wall; the attack may miss. Don't use Vayne E Condemn for simple poke. Save it to defend yourself or stun her against a wall.
Kalista.phase: Vayne is especially weak early, so minimize losses against Kalista and buy time. In mid game, keep farming instead of taking risky fights, and aim for your power spike in mid to late game when you have attack speed and penetration items. It's important to limit early losses until you complete three core items.
Kalista.teamfight: Join after your allies start the fight and the enemy's engage tools and targeted crowd control, such as Kalista R Fate's Call, have been used. If Kalista stays close to the support bound to her, spread out to avoid the spot where the support will land when thrown. Look for a Vayne E Condemn stun near a wall, then focus attacks on one target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Kalista.watch: Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend mainly deal physical damage. The moment Kalista E Rend cashes in several spears lodged in you is especially dangerous. If spears have stacked on you and your health is low, stop fighting and leave lane until they disappear. If the support bound to Kalista moves close to her before Kalista R Fate's Call, be ready to move away from the landing spot.

KogMaw.combo: When there's a wall behind Kog'Maw, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up the angle and push him into the wall with Vayne E Condemn to stun him. If there is no wall, save Vayne E Condemn so you don't push Kog'Maw out of range.
KogMaw.escape: The opportunity to go in with Vayne Q Tumble comes when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you've dodged the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle. Kog'Maw has no mobility, so once you close the gap, you can hold him with a Vayne E Condemn wall stun. Before going in, decide whether you need Vayne Q Tumble to disengage as well, and check your retreat path.
KogMaw.fight: Close the gap after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you've dodged Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle or E Void Ooze. When Kog'Maw steps forward to last-hit, attack the same target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble. Use Vayne E Condemn to stun him when there's a wall behind him; otherwise, save it for defense.
KogMaw.laning: If Kog'Maw approaches with W Bio-Arcane Barrage active, let its duration run out, then trade only when he steps forward to last-hit. Don't start a trade if you can't attack enough to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts.
KogMaw.phase: In mid game, look for openings when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is inactive, and coordinate an allied gank or roam against Kog'Maw, who has no mobility. Both champions become strong in late game, so don't let Kog'Maw attack freely; focus Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one target.
KogMaw.teamfight: Join after your allies start the fight and the enemy's engage tools and targeted crowd control have been used, using Vayne R Final Hour and Q Tumble. Approach in the opening after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and look for a Vayne E Condemn stun near a wall. After closing in, avoid switching targets often and focus Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks; if you kill Kog'Maw, move away from the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, its range and percent-max-health damage increase, so keep your distance until it ends. Block Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle with minions or dodge it to the side; if it hits you, don't engage while your resistances are reduced. When low on health, recover out of sight to avoid Kog'Maw R Living Artillery. After killing him, walk away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

Lucian.build: Withstand the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Lucian's main damage is physical and Vayne has low armor, so prioritize armor.
Lucian.combo: When Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down and there's a wall behind him, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up the angle, then push him into the wall with Vayne E Condemn to stun him. In areas without a wall, Vayne E Condemn can push Lucian out of range, so save it.
Lucian.escape: The moment after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit has been used is your window to go in. Back away if the enemy support's shield or healing empowers Lucian's next two shots, or if an ally becomes immobilized.
Lucian.fight: Dodge Lucian's opening combo and counterattack after his abilities have been used. Close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble immediately after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, but check your retreat path first. Keep attacking the same target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, then end the trade.
Lucian.laning: Don't force the lane forward early; keep the wave near your allied turret and farm. Start a trade only when Lucian steps forward to last-hit, and don't fight if you can't proc Vayne W Silver Bolts. Don't stand in a line with the minion Lucian is attacking, so you can avoid Lucian Q Piercing Light.
Lucian.phase: In mid game, putting more skill points into Vayne Q Tumble makes trades faster. Vayne's power rises sharply after you have three core items, so don't force a win early.
Lucian.teamfight: Join after your allies start the fight and the enemy's engage tools and targeted crowd control have been used. Look for an angle to stun a target with Vayne E Condemn near a wall. Once you close in, don't switch targets; focus Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one target. If Lucian R The Culling hits you, move to the side with Vayne Q Tumble.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light pierces minions and extends beyond its indicator range, so move out of the line behind a minion when Lucian attacks it. Lucian R The Culling can't change direction while channeling, so dodge to the side with Vayne Q Tumble. If Lucian's next two shots are empowered, don't trade damage; back away.

MissFortune.build: Withstand the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Miss Fortune P Love Tap, Q Double Up, and R Bullet Time mainly deal physical damage, so prioritize armor.
MissFortune.combo: Use Vayne Q Tumble to line up a wall behind Miss Fortune, then push her into it with Vayne E Condemn to stun her.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility, so close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble after the slow area from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain disappears.
MissFortune.fight: Trade briefly only when Miss Fortune steps forward to last-hit. Fight when you can keep hitting the same target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, then add the empowered basic attack from Vayne Q Tumble to your final hit and retreat.
MissFortune.laning: Don't force the lane forward early; keep it near your allied turret and farm. Immediately after Miss Fortune attacks a minion, create distance and avoid standing directly behind a minion to dodge the bounce from Miss Fortune Q Double Up. Save Vayne E Condemn unless you have an opportunity to use it on Miss Fortune with a wall behind her.
MissFortune.phase: Putting more skill points into Vayne Q Tumble makes trades faster, and Vayne becomes strong in mid to late game, so buy time without forcing things early.
MissFortune.teamfight: Delay your engage while Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is on the ground and draw the enemy outside its area. Join after your allies start the fight and the enemy's engage tools and targeted crowd control have been used, then focus Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one target. If you have an angle to push Miss Fortune into a wall while she's using Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, stun her with Vayne E Condemn to interrupt it.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces behind minions, so don't stand in a line with a minion. If Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is placed, its slow makes it hard to enter or leave, so move outside the area. Miss Fortune R Bullet Time locks its direction when cast, so move to the side of its cone instead of retreating straight back.

Nilah.build: Nilah's main damage is physical and Vayne has low armor, so first withstand it with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Account for the penetration on Nilah Q Formless Blade by building health along with armor.
Nilah.combo: After Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends, if Nilah has her back to a wall, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up the angle so there's a wall behind her. Then push her into the wall with Vayne E Condemn to stun her, and focus basic attacks on the same target during the stun to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts. If you used Vayne Q Tumble to engage, don't go so deep that you have no way to disengage.
Nilah.escape: It's best to go in when Nilah E Slipstream and W Jubilant Veil are down. Nilah E Slipstream can be used again, so if there's a wall, lock her down first with a Vayne E Condemn stun, then use Vayne Q Tumble to manage the distance. Don't go in from a position where Nilah R Apotheosis can pull you in while it's available.
Nilah.fight: Pressure Nilah from outside her range when she steps forward to last-hit, but back away immediately after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits. After Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends, focus basic attacks on one target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, then create distance again with Vayne Q Tumble. Save Vayne E Condemn for Nilah's approach unless you have an angle to stun her against a wall.
Nilah.laning: Pressure Nilah from outside her range only when she moves into melee to last-hit, and check your retreat path if you're within range of Nilah E Slipstream.
Nilah.phase: In mid game, putting more skill points into Vayne Q Tumble lets you trade more often, so stop Nilah from engaging and trade briefly. Vayne grows stronger with items in late game, so survive and focus Vayne W Silver Bolts on one target.
Nilah.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies aren't caught together by Nilah R Apotheosis, and go in after your allies start a fight and Nilah's engage tool has been used. After Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends, focus your attacks on one target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts. Near a wall, look for an angle to stun Nilah with Vayne E Condemn.
Nilah.watch: When Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range and area briefly increase, so step back further. While Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, basic attacks miss, so stop trading with basic attacks and wait for it to end. Spread out before a fight so multiple allies aren't pulled in together by Nilah R Apotheosis.

Samira.build: Withstand the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Samira's main damage is physical and Vayne has low armor, so prioritize armor.
Samira.combo: Use Vayne Q Tumble to position so there's a wall behind Samira, then push her into it with Vayne E Condemn to stun her. If Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, hold your basic attacks and Vayne E Condemn until the spin ends.
Samira.escape: If Samira E Wild Rush is down and no one has died to reset it, this is your window to close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble. Vayne P Night Hunter's movement speed doesn't apply while fleeing, so check your retreat path before engaging.
Samira.fight: Trade briefly after Samira E Wild Rush is down and Samira W Blade Whirl has ended. Stack basic attacks on the same target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble. If Samira has her back to a wall, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up the angle and push her into the wall with Vayne E Condemn to stun her.
Samira.laning: While Vayne is weak early, don't force the lane forward; keep it near your allied turret and farm. Try a short trade that can proc Vayne W Silver Bolts only when Samira steps forward to last-hit. If you don't have an angle for a wall stun, don't use Vayne E Condemn first; save it for Samira's engage.
Samira.phase: Putting more skill points into Vayne Q Tumble makes trades faster, and her damage rises sharply in mid to late game with attack speed and penetration items. Even then, fight during a window when Samira E Wild Rush is down so she can't engage in melee range.
Samira.teamfight: Join after your allies start the fight and the enemy's engage tools and targeted crowd control have been used. If Samira engages, push her away with Vayne E Condemn; if Samira R Inferno Trigger begins, interrupt it with Vayne E Condemn.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, hold your basic attacks and projectiles, then attack after it ends. If Samira gets close and lands several types of attacks, she can use Samira R Inferno Trigger, so keep your time in close range brief. Be alert when an ally is immobilized, since Samira P Daredevil Impulse can let her engage at that moment.

Senna.build: Withstand the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Senna's main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. If you are often caught by Senna W Last Embrace's root, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items. If the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness is enough to offset Vayne W Silver Bolts' damage, consider Executioner's Calling after one core item.
Senna.combo: When Senna W Last Embrace is down and there's a wall behind Senna, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up the angle. Then push Senna into the wall with Vayne E Condemn to stun her, and build Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on the same target with basic attacks and the empowered basic attack from Vayne Q Tumble. In areas without a wall, save Vayne E Condemn because it can push Senna out of range.
Senna.escape: Go in during the window after Senna W Last Embrace misses and the threat of a root is gone. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist approaching, back away first and reposition to fight somewhere with clear vision. Before going in, check your retreat path, accounting for the fact that Vayne P Night Hunter's movement speed doesn't apply while fleeing.
Senna.fight: Trade briefly when Senna steps forward to collect a soul or last-hit. Attack only when you can stack basic attacks on the same target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts, then use the empowered basic attack from Vayne Q Tumble as your final hit and retreat. After Senna W Last Embrace misses, you have an opportunity to close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble.
Senna.laning: Early on, don't force the lane forward against Senna's longer range; keep it near your allied turret and farm. Watch soul locations and poke when Senna steps forward to collect one, while avoiding the line where Senna Q Piercing Darkness can reach and the area Senna W Last Embrace can hit. If Senna hits you once, reposition immediately to prevent a second attack and Mist collection.
Senna.phase: Senna's range and attack damage increase as she collects Mist, so don't miss opportunities to catch her stepping forward to collect souls in mid game either. Vayne becomes stronger as you put skill points into Vayne Q Tumble and after completing three core items, so minimize early losses and buy time until then.
Senna.teamfight: Join after your allies start the fight and the enemy's engage tools and crowd control have been used. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, don't stand off in that spot; retreat somewhere with clear vision. Look for a Vayne E Condemn stun near a wall. Once you close in, focus your basic attacks on one target to proc Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness slows and heals, so move out of the line between Senna and the front minion. Senna W Last Embrace roots after a delay following a hit, so dodge it from behind minions, and immediately move away from allies if it marks you. If Senna has hit you once, back away so she can't hit you a second time and collect Mist.

Sivir.build: Sivir deals mostly physical damage, and Vayne has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If Sivir’s healing is enough to offset Vayne W Silver Bolts damage, fit Executioner's Calling in after one core item.
Sivir.combo: Act as if you’re going in to draw out Sivir E Spell Shield. Then use Vayne Q Tumble to position so there’s a wall behind Sivir, and stun her against it with Vayne E Condemn.
Sivir.escape: Sivir has no ability to create distance on her own, so the window to engage is when Sivir E Spell Shield is down. Close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble, but check your retreat route first. If you have a wall angle, use Vayne E Condemn. Avoid long chases while Sivir R On The Hunt is active.
Sivir.fight: When Sivir steps forward to last-hit, attack briefly to trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble. To engage, draw out Sivir E Spell Shield first, dodge the outward and return paths of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, then close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble. While Sivir R On The Hunt is active, take only short trades near terrain and vision.
Sivir.laning: Vayne is weak early, so don’t force the wave forward. Keep it near your turret and farm. If you dodge Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, she spends mana without getting anything in return. Sivir clears waves quickly, so push beforehand when leaving lane or make sure an ally is ready to catch the wave.
Sivir.phase: In the mid game, investing more points in Vayne Q Tumble lets you trade more quickly, but manage your time away from lane because Sivir clears waves fast. Vayne’s damage becomes strong from the mid to late game as she gets attack speed and penetration items, so it’s important to avoid falling behind early and buy time.
Sivir.teamfight: Wait for an ally to engage and for the enemy’s engage abilities and point-and-click crowd control to be used, then activate Vayne R Final Hour and go in. If Sivir E Spell Shield is down, close in with Vayne Q Tumble. Near a wall, look for a stun with Vayne E Condemn. Once you’re on a target, don’t switch targets; focus Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one champion.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit on both the way out and the way back. If the first hit lands, sidestep its return path with Vayne Q Tumble. Vayne E Condemn is blocked while Sivir E Spell Shield is available, so use it after drawing out the shield. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, her whole team moves faster, so avoid long chases.

Smolder.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first to withstand Smolder’s damage, but resistance cannot stop the true damage from Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. If Smolder’s healing is enough to offset Vayne W Silver Bolts damage, fit Executioner's Calling in after one core item.
Smolder.combo: If Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down and Smolder has his back to a wall, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up the wall behind him. Then stun him against it with Vayne E Condemn, and focus your basic attacks on the same target to trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts. Vayne Q Tumble cannot cross walls, so also check the route you will use to disengage after going in.
Smolder.escape: Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is his only escape, so close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble right after he uses it. Going in after dodging Smolder W Achooo! reduces the chance of being slowed and hit by follow-up attacks. Save Vayne E Condemn until you have an angle with Smolder's back to a wall or a moment when you need to defend yourself.
Smolder.fight: When Smolder steps forward to last-hit, focus your attacks on the same target to trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts once, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble. When Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble, but check your retreat route before going in. If Smolder has a wall behind him, stun him against it with Vayne E Condemn.
Smolder.laning: Smolder grows stronger by hitting champions with abilities or killing enemies with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath, so avoid his poke and disrupt his farming when he steps forward to last-hit. When Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, it’s a good opportunity to pressure him with your jungler.
Smolder.phase: Vayne is weak early too, but Smolder is weakest before he has stacks, so pressure him when he steps forward to last-hit and slow his growth. In the mid game, focus on securing objectives and turrets quickly to close out the game. The longer the game goes, the more Smolder’s permanent growth puts you at a disadvantage.
Smolder.teamfight: Vayne doesn’t start teamfights. Join after an ally engages and the enemy’s engage abilities and point-and-click crowd control have been used. Fight near a wall to look for a stun with Vayne E Condemn, and once you’re on a target, don’t switch targets; build Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one champion. Move out of the area where Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! lands, then re-engage.
Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! explodes and slows when it hits a champion, making it easy to get hit by follow-up attacks, so stand behind minions or sidestep it. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so move out of the flames, then re-engage. As Smolder grows, Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath gains max-health-based true damage and an execute, so be especially careful at low health.

Tristana.combo: Use Vayne Q Tumble to position so there’s a wall behind Tristana, then knock her into it with Vayne E Condemn to stun her. In a short trade, build stacks with basic attacks and land the final hit with the empowered basic attack from Vayne Q Tumble.
Tristana.escape: Right after Tristana uses Tristana W Rocket Jump, you have a window to close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble. Engage when Tristana R Buster Shot is also down and Vayne E Condemn is ready. Before going in, check whether you have a route to use Vayne Q Tumble to disengage.
Tristana.fight: When Tristana steps forward to last-hit, attack briefly to trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble. Right after Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble. Don’t rush an engage if Tristana R Buster Shot is still available.
Tristana.laning: Don’t force the wave forward early; keep it near your turret and farm. Stand away from minions when Tristana kills them so you don’t get hit by the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. Don’t use Vayne E Condemn to poke unless Tristana has her back to a wall.
Tristana.phase: Vayne gets stronger in the mid to late game as she completes her abilities and items. A fully built Tristana is difficult to handle, so play to end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: Engage after an ally starts the fight and Tristana’s engage ability and crowd control have been used. Look for a stun with Vayne E Condemn near a wall, and focus your attacks on one target to trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts. If your allies go down and the fight turns against you, watch for a chain engage with Tristana W Rocket Jump resets and retreat immediately.
Tristana.watch: Don’t stand close to allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. Don’t engage first while both Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are available. Vayne E Condemn can interrupt Tristana W Rocket Jump while she’s airborne.

TwistedFate.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Twisted Fate’s ability damage. Movement speed is also important for getting out of telegraphed attack areas. In the mid to late game, build attack speed and penetration items to increase Vayne’s damage.
TwistedFate.combo: When Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is down and there’s a wall behind him, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up Vayne E Condemn and stun him against the wall. During the stun, attack the same target with basic attacks to build Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks. Just before Vayne W Silver Bolts triggers, land the final attack with the empowered basic attack from Vayne Q Tumble.
TwistedFate.escape: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card has also been used, close in with Vayne Q Tumble. If there’s a wall behind him, knock him into it with Vayne E Condemn to stun him. In open areas, save it so you don’t push him out of range.
TwistedFate.fight: When Twisted Fate steps forward to last-hit, take a short trade, and fight only when you can trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts. Right after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used, you have a chance to close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble. Before going in, check whether you have a route to use Vayne Q Tumble to disengage.
TwistedFate.laning: Don’t force the wave forward early; keep it near your turret and farm. Reduce poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards by standing behind minions, and stay out of basic attack range while Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has a gold card. Alert your allies immediately if Twisted Fate looks ready to roam.
TwistedFate.phase: Vayne gets strong in the mid to late game as she builds attack speed and penetration items, so survive the early game and scale.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Engage after an ally starts the fight and Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card and the enemy’s engage ability have been used. Near a wall, look for a stun on Twisted Fate with Vayne E Condemn, and focus Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on the target you’ve started attacking. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny being used within range, Vayne E Condemn can interrupt his movement.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of his range. Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards is area poke, so stand behind minions to reduce the damage.

Twitch.build: Get a Control Ward early to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, and Twitch P Deadly Venom deals true damage, so building only one type of resistance won’t block all of it. Build up your health pool and consider ways to reduce his attack speed.
Twitch.combo: Use Vayne Q Tumble to position so there’s a wall behind Twitch, then knock him into it with Vayne E Condemn to stun him. Without a wall, Vayne E Condemn can push Twitch out of range, so don’t force this sequence.
Twitch.escape: Look for an opportunity to engage when Twitch W Venom Cask is down and Twitch Q Ambush’s camouflage ends. Twitch has no separate escape ability, so close in with Vayne Q Tumble, but account for the movement speed from Twitch Q Ambush and check your retreat route before going in. Use Vayne E Condemn when you can look for a wall stun or save it for defense.
Twitch.fight: When Twitch steps forward to last-hit, take a short trade and fight only when you can trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts on the same target. Don’t stay in Twitch W Venom Cask to deal more damage; escape with Vayne Q Tumble. If Twitch loses camouflage and you have a chance to close in, check your retreat route before engaging.
Twitch.laning: Vayne is weak early and has short basic attack range, so don’t force the wave forward; keep it near your turret and farm. Avoid brush where there is no vision and narrow paths, or check them first with a Control Ward. Alert your allies if Twitch disappears from lane.
Twitch.phase: Vayne gets stronger in the mid to late game as she builds attack speed and penetration items, so avoid forced fights until then. The available information doesn’t establish whether Twitch or Vayne is stronger at each point in the game.
Twitch.teamfight: Wait for an ally to start the fight and for the enemy’s engage abilities and point-and-click crowd control to be used, then activate Vayne R Final Hour and go in while repositioning with Vayne Q Tumble. Spread out to the side so you and your allies aren’t all hit by Twitch R Spray and Pray’s piercing attacks. When Twitch loses camouflage, coordinate your attacks with your allies on the same target, and once you’re on a target, focus Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one champion.
Twitch.watch: The cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask slows and stacks Deadly Venom, so leave it immediately if it lands under your feet. After Twitch P Deadly Venom stacks, Twitch E Contaminate can finish you even when you’re around half health, so check how many basic attacks have hit you and create distance early. Twitch R Spray and Pray increases his range and lets his attacks pierce, so don’t line up with your allies.

Varus.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Varus’s main physical damage and basic attacks. Fit Quicksilver Sash between core items to prepare for being rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption.
Varus.combo: Use Vayne Q Tumble to position so there’s a wall behind Varus, then knock him into it with Vayne E Condemn to stun him. If there’s no wall, Vayne E Condemn can push Varus out of range, so save it.
Varus.escape: The opportunity to engage is when Varus R Chain of Corruption is down and he starts aiming Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Sidestep the arrow’s path, then close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble. Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, but check your retreat route before going in.
Varus.fight: When Varus steps forward to last-hit, trade by attacking the same target to trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts. Dodge Varus Q Piercing Arrow to the side and look for a chance to close in while Varus has slowed himself. When engaging, also check whether you can use Vayne Q Tumble to disengage.
Varus.laning: Vayne has low health and armor early, and short basic attack range, so don’t force the wave forward; farm near your turret. Don’t start short trades when you can’t trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts. Healing is reduced in the area left by Varus E Hail of Arrows, so move out of it.
Varus.phase: In the mid game, investing more points in Vayne Q Tumble lets you trade more often, so look for opportunities when Varus’s abilities are down. Vayne gets stronger in the late game as she builds attack speed and penetration items, so focus on surviving early and completing core items.
Varus.teamfight: Wait for an ally to engage and for crowd control, including Varus R Chain of Corruption, to be used, then activate Vayne R Final Hour and go in with Vayne Q Tumble. If an ally is rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption, move away so the tendrils can’t reach you. If Varus gets a takedown or assist, wait for the enhanced duration to end. Near a wall, look for a stun with Vayne E Condemn, and once you’re on a target, focus Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one champion.
Varus.watch: If Varus hits you with an ability while Blight from Varus W Blighted Quiver has stacked, it triggers bonus damage based on your max health. If you’ve been hit by several of Varus’s basic attacks, back off and give the stacks time to disappear. If you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow being aimed, sidestep its path with Vayne Q Tumble. If an ally is rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption, move away so the root doesn’t spread.

Yasuo.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo deals mostly physical damage, and Vayne has low armor, so build armor first.
Yasuo.combo: When you have a clear angle against a wall, use Vayne Q Tumble to position so there’s a wall behind Yasuo, then knock him into it with Vayne E Condemn to stun him. If your earlier attacks have built stacks, land the final hit with the empowered basic attack from Vayne Q Tumble.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, his stacks reset and you have an opportunity to go in. Don’t chase just because Yasuo used Yasuo E Sweeping Blade once. Close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again only when you can also apply crowd control. If there’s a wall angle then, stun him with Vayne E Condemn, but check your retreat route before going in.
Yasuo.fight: Use brief poke to remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield before taking a full trade. If Yasuo steps up to last-hit and has just used his tornado, focus your attacks on one target to trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is still present, reposition to go around it or attack after it disappears.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin to reduce the number of minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use to dash in. Don’t use Vayne E Condemn for simple poke; save it in case Yasuo gets on you.
Yasuo.phase: Investing more points in Vayne Q Tumble makes trades come around faster, and Vayne gets strong in the mid to late game as she builds attack speed and penetration items. Prioritize farming and survival over forced fights until you complete three core items.
Yasuo.teamfight: Vayne doesn’t start teamfights. Engage after your allies start the fight and Yasuo’s engage abilities and knock-up have been used. Fight in narrow terrain near a wall to set up a stun with Vayne E Condemn. Once you’re on a target, avoid switching targets often; focus your attacks on one champion to trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use minions to close the gap, so watch his approach when there are many minions nearby. After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, he prepares a tornado knock-up, so watch for the sound and visual effect and sidestep. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, go around it or save projectile attacks until it disappears.

Zeri.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zeri’s main damage, Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, deals physical damage, so build armor first. Zeri P Living Battery scales with maximum health and executes low-health enemies, so keep total health in mind too.
Zeri.combo: After Zeri E Spark Surge is down, use Vayne Q Tumble to line up an angle, then push Zeri with Vayne E Condemn to stun her when there’s a wall behind her. If Zeri E Spark Surge is available, she can use terrain to escape, so avoid engaging by driving her toward a wall.
Zeri.escape: The moment after you force Zeri E Spark Surge is your window to go in with Vayne Q Tumble. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is also active, her movement speed increases, so don’t extend the chase. After using Vayne Q Tumble to engage, you have fewer ways to disengage, so check your retreat path before going in.
Zeri.fight: When Zeri steps forward to last-hit, attack briefly to trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble. If Zeri E Spark Surge is down, it’s an opportunity to close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble. Check your retreat path before going in, and save Vayne E Condemn unless you have an angle to stun her against a wall.
Zeri.laning: Zeri has little kill pressure before her core items, but Vayne should still prioritize avoiding early losses. Don’t start a short trade if you can’t trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts.
Zeri.phase: Before Zeri completes her core items, look for opportunities when Zeri E Spark Surge is down. In the mid to late game, Vayne gets stronger as she completes items, but Zeri also becomes harder to catch because of her mobility, so avoid chasing recklessly.
Zeri.teamfight: Don’t start fights as Vayne. Go in after an ally engages and the enemy’s engage abilities and point-and-click crowd control are down. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, don’t try to catch her on foot; look for an angle to stun her against a wall with Vayne E Condemn. Once you start attacking, don’t switch targets often; focus Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one target.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads out when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall or face her head-on in a narrow corridor. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing terrain, so pushing her toward a wall gives her a chance to escape. After Zeri R Lightning Crash is activated, her movement speed increases, so don’t chase recklessly.

Ziggs.build: The information provided isn’t enough to determine your first purchase. The resistance you need against Ziggs’ damage is magic resistance, not armor. Also consider movement speed, which helps you walk out of telegraphed attack areas.
Ziggs.combo: When Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down and there’s a wall behind Ziggs, line up an angle with Vayne Q Tumble, then push Ziggs into the wall with Vayne E Condemn to stun him. When using Vayne E Condemn, the wall must be behind Ziggs, not behind Vayne.
Ziggs.escape: The moment after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down is your window to engage. Secure a route without Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, close the gap with Vayne Q Tumble, and use Vayne E Condemn if you get an angle to pin him against a wall. Check your retreat path first as well.
Ziggs.fight: The moment after Ziggs uses W Satchel Charge is your opportunity to close the gap. Approach along a path without Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, attack the same target to trigger Vayne W Silver Bolts, then retreat with Vayne Q Tumble.
Ziggs.laning: Don’t force the lane early; farm near your allied turret and minimize losses. Try to trade when Ziggs steps forward to last-hit or just after he uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to poke or clear the wave. Don’t enter a path blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield.
Ziggs.phase: The more you invest in Vayne Q Tumble, the faster your trade rotation becomes. Vayne gets stronger from the mid to late game, when attack speed and penetration items come together. Against Ziggs, minimize early losses and buy time until then.
Ziggs.teamfight: Engage after an ally starts the fight and the enemy’s engage abilities and point-and-click crowd control are down. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, approach along a path without mines and look for a chance to stun him with Vayne E Condemn near a wall. After engaging, don’t switch targets often; focus Vayne W Silver Bolts stacks on one target.
Ziggs.watch: Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you when you step on it, making it easier to get hit by his other abilities, so go around the mined path or wait for it to disappear. When the area of Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, move away from the center of the blast even if you can’t get fully clear. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is available, he can knock you back to create distance or escape over a wall.
